status: development evidence only; no authority to open 2025 or promote a strategy
sources: Chicago Fed Letter 464 (2021), real rates and long-run gold
Christie-David et al. (2000), intraday gold and silver news responses
population: Only 2023 and 2024 HistData complete M15 bid candles. Decision at quarter hour uses completed bars. FX/XAG use one extra M15 reporting lag. BLS release occurrence only at least one minute after verified release. No revised macro values. Use exact joins, no quote forward fill. Weekdays 07:00 to 21:00 UTC.
missing: Take common eligible timestamps across ablations. A whole unavailable cross asset may be excluded prior to any score, documenting it. No synthetic substitution. If all cross assets fail, record unavailable ablation.
labels: Direction from current bid close to future bid close (strictly up). Complete short horizon quarter paths required. One-day endpoint same UTC next calendar day, weekday, at least 88 complete intervening quarters with normal maintenance allowed, no weekend crossing. Absolute log return in bp; realized vol root sum four squared quarter returns. Large = absolute H1 return above 1.5 times trailing H1 realized vol. Upper first = one trailing H1 volatility price unit touched upward before equal lower barrier in next hour; neither is negative, ambiguous first M1 touch censored.
models: Standardized logistic regression (L2 penalized mean loss) and ridge on log continuous targets; intercept unpenalized. Groups gold, gold+available FX/metals, gold+cross+CPI post-publication indicator and interaction. One fixed interaction for dollar proxy and gold trend. No unrestricted model search.
predictors: Gold trailing 1/4/16 quarter log returns and 4/16 quarter realized volatility, most recent range, cyclic UTC hour. Cross group 1/4 quarter log returns per available instrument; sign-adjusted dollar proxy and lagged gold one-hour interaction. CPI post-release flag through 60 minutes and interaction with gold volatility.
budget: 9 targets x 3 groups x 2 regularization strengths (0.001,0.1). 4 expanding 2024 quarterly outer folds. Select strength per target/group using last 90 days of training as inner temporal validation; train on earlier portion only. Exclude one full day before both cutoffs for all labels. Never select on outer-quarter scores. Seed 1951. No second search.
references: Train-only climatology and random fair-coin probability (0.5) for direction; conditional probability by sign of latest gold return; other binary targets climatology and fixed incidence by UTC hour. Continuous median by UTC hour, global median, trailing H1 realized volatility persistence. Compare against each benchmark plus incremental paired group losses.
inference: Brier for binary, MAE in bp for continuous. Daily mean paired loss differences on identical samples; 5000 circular 5-day block bootstrap with Bonferroni over 9 targets x 3 model groups x 5 contrasts = 135. 95% two-sided nominal and one-sided corrected lower bound. Report fold means, sample size, hit rate and calibration for classification. Candidate information needs positive primary-reference advantage in all 4 folds and corrected lower bound >0 vs each reference; cross value additionally must beat simpler group. Interpret as development only.
economic: Diagnostic only: for 60min full model direction, abs(p-0.5)>=0.10, one nonoverlapping exposure, enter next complete minute open one minute after issue, exit after 60 minutes, handle any missing execution path by abstention. USD/oz spread 0.50 + 0.10 slip each side; stress double and 5-minute delay. Compare per opportunity with cash. No optimizing threshold or claiming a tradable strategy. Phase 2 gates stay in force.
new_data: 2025 sealed with zero evaluation. Previously studied 2026 is not a clean holdout. Reserve Jan-Jun 2027 for one prospective replication of subsequently frozen artifact, subject to dated data and a forecast ledger; no scheduling or collection activated.
llm: Seven fixed project tasks, two Groq models (gpt-oss-20b, gpt-oss-120b if listed and free). Strict JSON Schema, one retry for malformed output or transient error; no feedback on answer quality. Score hidden per-case decision and two independent evidence fields; select only with >=6/7 correct decisions and >=18/21 points. Record raw answers, tokens and latency, list cost separately from actual bill. No code generation or production integration.
